User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application, linked to an external authentication system and assigned specific roles. Passwords and sensitive authentication data are managed by Firebase Auth and not stored here.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

firebaseUid.description: Unique identifier provided by Firebase Authentication for this user account. This links the app's internal user profile to the external authentication system.

name.description: The display name of the user.

role.description: The role of the user within the application (e.g., 'ADMIN', 'CASHIER'). This determines their access privileges.

storeId.description: Reference to the Store entity if the user's role is 'CASHIER', indicating which store they operate in. (Relationship: Store 1:N User)

Store.title: Store
Store.description: Represents a physical store location within the retail business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Store entity.

name.description: The name of the store (e.g., 'Toko A', 'Toko B').

location.description: The physical address or general location description of the store.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a single product that can be sold in the stores.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

category.description: The category to which the product belongs (e.g., 'T-Shirt', 'Pants', 'Accessories').

price.description: The standard selling price of the product.

Stock.title: Stock
Stock.description: Represents the current quantity of a specific product available at a particular store. This is the live inventory count.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Stock entry.

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity whose stock is being tracked. (Relationship: Product 1:N Stock)

storeId.description: Reference to the Store entity where this product's stock is located. (Relationship: Store 1:N Stock)

quantity.description: The current numerical quantity of the product in stock at this specific store.

lowStockThreshold.description: The quantity level below which this product's stock at this store is considered low, triggering alerts.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when this stock entry was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a single sales transaction, capturing details like date, total amount, and associated store/cashier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction was completed.

storeId.description: Reference to the Store entity where this transaction took place. (Relationship: Store 1:N Transaction)

cashierId.description: Reference to the User entity (cashier) who processed this transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the transaction, including all items.

paymentAmount.description: The total monetary amount provided by the customer for payment.

changeAmount.description: The monetary amount of change given back to the customer.

status.description: The current status of the transaction (e.g., 'completed', 'pending', 'refunded').

TransactionItem.title: TransactionItem
TransactionItem.description: Represents a single product line item within a sales transaction, detailing the quantity and price at the time of sale.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TransactionItem entity.

transactionId.description: Reference to the parent Transaction entity to which this item belongs. (Relationship: Transaction 1:N TransactionItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity that was sold in this line item. (Relationship: Product 1:N TransactionItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the product sold in this particular line item.

priceAtSale.description: The price of the product at the exact moment of sale for this item, preserving historical pricing.

subtotal.description: The calculated subtotal for this line item (quantity * priceAtSale).

StockLog.title: StockLog
StockLog.description: Records all historical changes and movements of product stock for auditing, tracking, and reporting purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StockLog entry.

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity whose stock was affected by this log entry. (Relationship: Product 1:N StockLog)

storeId.description: Reference to the originating Store entity where the stock change occurred or was initiated. (Relationship: Store 1:N StockLog)

quantityChange.description: The numerical change in stock quantity. Positive for increases (restock), negative for decreases (sale).

oldQuantity.description: The stock quantity before this specific change occurred.

newQuantity.description: The stock quantity after this specific change occurred.

timestamp.description: The date and time when this stock change was recorded.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity who initiated or recorded this stock change. (Relationship: User 1:N StockLog)

targetStoreId.description: Reference to the target Store entity for stock mutation operations (e.g., the destination store for a 'mutation_out' change type). (Relationship: Store 1:N StockLog)

MutationRequest.title: MutationRequest
MutationRequest.description: Permintaan mutasi barang antar cabang toko.
